faq.q: Is there a TikTok Shop reviews API?
faq.a: Only for sellers managing their own shop. This actor reads every public review of any product: rating, text, photos, verified-purchase and incentivized flags, variant and date.

faq.q: Can I use it as a TikTok Shop reviews API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: TikTok Shop's Partner API is for sellers managing their own shop. This actor reads the public reviews on any TikTok Shop product page in 16 markets.
